source_boundary.source_lead: Gerald Teschl, Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems, AMS GSM 140 (2012), Section 7.3. Lemma 7.13 says that a nonempty compact forward or backward omega-limit set containing no fixed points is a regular periodic orbit. Theorem 7.16 instead gives a generalized finite-fixed-point classification. The official page-222 erratum says the printed Lemma 7.13 proof establishes only containment and requires Lemma 7.14 plus connectedness derived from compactness for equality; it also removes Theorem 7.16's connectedness assumption.
source_boundary.source_model_boundary: Teschl's setup uses a C1 vector field on an open planar domain and its source-defined maximal local flow on a varying maximal interval. Mathlib's Flow is global on its carrier. Replacing the source model by a global Flow on the plane or on the domain subtype would be a nontrivial specialization, not a notation-only encoding decision.
